findings.finding: Pangolin is not in the current xenarthran profile. Canonical xenarthran contains Sloth and Armadillo; Pangolin is in toothless-clawed-mammal.
findings.requiredCorrection: Replace Armadillo/Pangolin with Armadillo. Keep the prohibition on a blanket xenarthran=fur mapping.

findings.finding: The required partition mentions neck/limbs but omits exposed tails. Base plated initializes all resolved joints to plated; unoverridden quadruped tail secondary joints then have zero lag and rigid=true.
findings.requiredCorrection: Require source-authored scaled head/neck, exposed limb and exposed tail joints, only where those resolved joints have observed source ownership. Explicitly keep each turtle PARTITION_PENDING until that actual record is authored and checked; do not use the body-only row as an admissible whole-animal material patch. Do not invent hidden roots or fill absent chains.

findings.finding: The handoff currently binds only short ID/name/profile, not exact source bytes. A future source of the same identity could silently inherit this visual judgment.
findings.requiredCorrection: Add exact C233 master relative path and SHA-256 plus canonical subject-source binding to each row, retaining its visual-review scope. Require a new review if source bytes differ.

findings.target: handoff README shell/body stays rigid wording
findings.finding: Closed material tags are supported, but the inspected implementation does not make them a general rigid-shell geometry constraint. Per-joint overrides feed secondary chains and the amplitude profile; for current quadrupeds neck/limb materials are not independent secondary chains, and the amplitude logic only has special material scaling for plant/translucent arm cases. Group materials remain the body default.
findings.requiredCorrection: Say proposed shell/body material is plated; observed shell ownership and motion rigidity still require authoring and verification. Do not claim that neck/limb overrides alone establish anatomically correct primary motion or a rigid shell. Keep fit/native admission unmeasured.
